question: What is the name of the building, total number of subjects, total fee, and shortest and longest sessions for each physical IAP session location?
statements:
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "iap_subject_session" AS SELECT "iap_subject_session_key" AS "iap_subject_session_key", "session_sequence" AS "session_sequence", "session_location" AS "session_location", "session_date" AS "session_date", "session_start_time" AS "session_start_time", "session_end_time" AS "session_end_time" FROM beaver."iap_subject_session";
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "iap_subject_detail" AS SELECT "iap_subject_session_key" AS "iap_subject_session_key", "activity_title" AS "activity_title", "fee" AS "fee", "is_cancelled" AS "is_cancelled" FROM beaver."iap_subject_detail";
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "fclt_rooms" AS SELECT "building_room" AS "building_room", "room_full_name" AS "room_full_name", "fclt_building_key" AS "fclt_building_key" FROM beaver."fclt_rooms";
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "fclt_building_hist_1" AS SELECT "fclt_building_key" AS "fclt_building_key", "building_number" AS "building_number", "building_name_long" AS "building_name_long", "campus_sector" AS "campus_sector" FROM beaver."fclt_building_hist_1";

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH sessions AS (
  SELECT 
    d.iap_subject_session_key,
    d.fee,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(s.session_location), '' ''), '') AS session_location,
    s.session_date,
    s.session_start_time,
    s.session_end_time
  FROM iap_subject_session s
  JOIN iap_subject_detail d
    ON d.iap_subject_session_key = s.iap_subject_session_key
  WHERE COALESCE(d.is_cancelled, 'N') <> 'Y'
),
phys AS (
  SELECT 
    iap_subject_session_key,
    fee,
    session_date,
    session_start_time,
    session_end_time,
    -- Extract candidate building-room token: allow patterns like '1-080', '32-155', possibly embedded in text
    REGEXP_EXTRACT(session_location, '([A-Za-z0-9]+-[A-Za-z0-9]+)') AS building_room_token
  FROM sessions
  WHERE session_location IS NOT NULL
    AND LOWER(session_location) NOT LIKE '%virtual%'
    AND LOWER(session_location) NOT LIKE '%zoom%'
    AND LOWER(session_location) NOT LIKE '%online%'
),
matched_room AS (
  SELECT p.*, r.fclt_building_key, r.building_room
  FROM phys p
  JOIN fclt_rooms r
    ON UPPER(p.building_room_token) = UPPER(r.building_room)
),
with_building AS (
  SELECT m.*, b.building_number, b.building_name_long
  FROM matched_room m
  LEFT JOIN fclt_building_hist_1 b
    ON m.fclt_building_key = b.fclt_building_key
),
with_minutes AS (
  SELECT 
    iap_subject_session_key,
    fee,
    building_number,
    building_name_long,
    session_date,
    session_start_time,
    session_end_time,
    -- Parse times like 0100PM using STRPTIME and format %I%M%p
    CASE 
      WHEN session_start_time IS NULL OR session_end_time IS NULL THEN NULL
      ELSE CAST((
        (STRFTIME(STRPTIME(session_end_time, '%I%M%p'), '%H')::INT*60 + STRFTIME(STRPTIME(session_end_time, '%I%M%p'), '%M')::INT)
        -
        (STRFTIME(STRPTIME(session_start_time, '%I%M%p'), '%H')::INT*60 + STRFTIME(STRPTIME(session_start_time, '%I%M%p'), '%M')::INT)
      ) AS INT)
    END AS duration_minutes
  FROM with_building
),
by_location AS (
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(building_name_long, CONCAT('Building ', COALESCE(building_number, 'Unknown'))) AS building_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT iap_subject_session_key) AS total_subjects,
    SUM(DISTINCT fee) FILTER (WHERE fee IS NOT NULL) AS total_fee_proxy,
    MIN(duration_minutes) AS shortest_session_minutes,
    MAX(duration_minutes) AS longest_session_minutes
  FROM with_minutes
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT 
  building_name,
  total_subjects,
  total_fee_proxy AS total_fee,
  shortest_session_minutes,
  longest_session_minutes
FROM by_location
ORDER BY building_name
LIMIT 200;

    subj.meet_end_time,
    subj.iap_date
  FROM subject_iap_schedule subj

  SELECT 
    s.iap_subject_session_key,

    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(s.session_location), ''), '') AS loc_text,
    s.session_start_time AS start_time,
    s.session_end_time AS end_time
  FROM sessions s
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    d.iap_subject_session_key,
    d.fee,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(sc.meet_place), ''), '') AS loc_text,
    sc.meet_start_time AS start_time,

),
filtered AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT 
    iap_subject_session_key,
    fee,
    loc_text,
    start_time,
    end_time

    AND LOWER(loc_text) NOT LIKE '%virtual%'
    AND LOWER(loc_text) NOT LIKE '%zoom%'
    AND LOWER(loc_text) NOT LIKE '%online%'

tokens AS (

    REGEXP_EXTRACT(f.loc_text, '([A-Za-z0-9]+-[A-Za-z0-9]+)') AS building_room_token,
    REGEXP_EXTRACT(f.loc_text, '^\s*([0-9A-Za-z]+) ') AS leading_building_token
  FROM filtered f

room_match AS (
  SELECT t.*, r.fclt_building_key, r.building_room

    rm.fee,
    rm.start_time,
    rm.end_time,

  LEFT JOIN fclt_building_hist_1 b
    ON rm.fclt_building_key = b.fclt_building_key
),
-- Fallback: if no room match, interpret leading token as building_number and map
bld_fallback AS (

    t.iap_subject_session_key,
    t.fee,
    t.start_time,
    t.end_time,
    b.building_number,

    ON UPPER(t.leading_building_token) = UPPER(b.building_number)

union_bld AS (
